critical_stages: Nursery (20d), Tillering (40d), Panicle (65d), Flowering (85d), Milking (105d), Maturity (130d)
high_risk_threats: Rice Blast, Stem Borer, Bacterial Leaf Blight
agronomic_milestone_actions: Drain nursery beds 2 days before transplant; maintain 2-3 cm standing water at panicle stage; stop water 10 days before harvest

critical_stages: Crown Root Initiation (21d), Tillering (45d), Jointing (65d), Heading (85d), Milking (105d), Dough (120d)
high_risk_threats: Yellow Rust, Aphids, Termites, Loose Smut
agronomic_milestone_actions: First irrigation at CRI (21 days) is critical for tillering; avoid delay in sowing beyond Nov 30 to escape terminal heat stress

critical_stages: Germination (7d), Square Formation (45d), Flowering (70d), Boll Formation (95d), Boll Opening (130d), Harvest (160d)
high_risk_threats: Pink Bollworm, Thrips, Whiteflies, Bacterial Blight
agronomic_milestone_actions: Install pheromone traps at 45 days; detop plants at 85 days to curb vegetative growth; monitor square drop weekly

critical_stages: Emergence (5d), Vegetative (25d), Flowering (45d), Pod Formation (65d), Seed Fill (80d), Maturity (95d)
high_risk_threats: Soybean Rust, Stem Fly, Anthracnose, Spodoptera
agronomic_milestone_actions: Seed treatment with Rhizobium and Trichoderma; avoid water stagnation during germination; spray fungicide at first rust sighting

critical_stages: Knee-High (30d), Tasseling (55d), Silking (62d), Milking (80d), Dough (95d), Maturity (105d)
high_risk_threats: Fall Armyworm (FAW), Maydis Leaf Blight, Stem Borer
agronomic_milestone_actions: Check central whorls weekly for FAW egg masses; ensure moisture availability during silking and grain filling stages

critical_stages: Transplanting (25d), Vegetative (45d), Flowering (60d), Fruit Set (75d), Harvest (90-130d)
high_risk_threats: Early Blight, Late Blight, Whiteflies, Fruit Borer
agronomic_milestone_actions: Stake indeterminate plants upright; mulch with straw to prevent soil splash; deploy yellow sticky cards and pheromone traps

critical_stages: Sprouting (15d), Vegetative (35d), Tuber Initiation (50d), Tuber Bulking (70d), Senescence (90d), Harvest (105d)
high_risk_threats: Late Blight, Black Scurf, Aphids, Tuber Rot
agronomic_milestone_actions: Earth up ridges to 15 cm at 30 days; prophylactic mancozeb spray before foggy spell; haulm cutting 10 days before harvest

critical_stages: Germination (40d), Formative / Tillering (120d), Grand Growth (240d), Ripening & Maturity (330d)
high_risk_threats: Red Rot, Early Shoot Borer, Top Borer, Pyrilla
agronomic_milestone_actions: Trash mulching to conserve moisture; earthing up to prevent lodging; hot water seed treatment (52C 30 min) to eradicate red rot

critical_stages: Emergence (7d), Flowering (30d), Pegging (45d), Pod Formation (70d), Pod Maturation (100d), Harvest (115d)
high_risk_threats: Tikka Leaf Spot, Collar Rot, Thrips, White Grubs
agronomic_milestone_actions: Do not disturb soil after pegging starts; apply gypsum (200 kg/ha) at pegging for calcium uptake; prevent water stagnation

critical_stages: Seedling (20d), Branching (40d), Flowering (60d), Pod Development (80d), Maturity (105d)
high_risk_threats: Fusarium Wilt, Helicoverpa Pod Borer, Ascochyta Blight
agronomic_milestone_actions: Nip terminal shoots at 35-40 days to promote lateral branching; install bird perches @ 25/acre; avoid excess irrigation

critical_stages: Germination (5d), Rosette (30d), Flowering (55d), Siliqua Formation (75d), Seed Fill (95d), Harvest (115d)
high_risk_threats: Mustard Aphids, White Rust, Alternaria Blight
agronomic_milestone_actions: Sow early in October to escape aphid explosion; thin plants to 10-15 cm intra-row spacing; spray dimethoate at ETL

critical_stages: Flush Emergence, Anthesis / Bloom, Fruit Set, Fruit Enlargement, Color Break, Harvest
high_risk_threats: Citrus Psylla, Leaf Miner, Citrus Canker, Gummosis
agronomic_milestone_actions: Withhold water for 30-40 days before bloom to induce flowering; prune dry twigs; paint trunks with Bordeaux paste 1:1:10
